title: Retractable hooks and garment rod Wall Mount 10-Inch Solid Brass Pullout Rod for Towels & Clothes Allied Brass
description:
Add convenient hanging space that tucks away with this retractable hooks and garment rod. The wall mount pullout rod extends to hang garments, clothes, or towels, then retracts when not in use—an easy fit for traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.

Highlights:
- Retractable pullout garment rod helps keep bathrooms, laundry rooms, and dressing areas organized
- Wall mount installation fits an end wall or door frame; concealed screw mounting hardware
- Solid brass construction
- Includes brass rod, rod housing, and all installation hardware
- Offered in multiple lifetime designer finish options, including statement colors

Specs:
- 10-Inch projection/length
- Dimensions: 10-Inch L x 2-Inch W x 1.9-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Requires 10 inches of wall depth to retract
- Limited Lifetime Warranty
